name: IchimaruPlus OGP for X
author: ichimaruplus

sections.description:
IchimaruPlus OGP for X provides metadata for image link previews when a public page URL is shared on X. It uses the featured image, title, excerpt or content, and public taxonomy terms already saved in WordPress. It does not compose new artwork or add card-specific fields to the post editor. Optional browser-based SVG-to-PNG conversion is off by default.

The plugin is designed for X link cards. It supports public posts, pages, publicly viewable custom post types, and a static-page homepage. Private posts, password-protected content, previews, embeds, feeds, archives and search results are excluded.

Select the pages to include

Open Settings > IchimaruPlus OGP for X to select post types. Posts and pages are enabled by default. Public custom post types are listed automatically and must be selected before they are included. Deselecting every type stops metadata output.

Leave a post type unchecked if another theme or plugin already provides its card metadata. When recognized SEO integrations are active, this plugin withholds metadata by default to help avoid duplicate output. It does not detect every possible theme or integration.

Choose the card title

Choose Title only or Title – Site name. The default is Title only. The site name comes from Site Title in Settings > General. The original article title is not changed. An empty site name does not add a separator.

The settings preview uses the latest public article in the saved scope, with sample content when an article or image is unavailable. Title-format changes appear immediately. It illustrates a title over the image and a domain below it. Actual layouts, cropping and visible text on X may differ.

Existing content is used directly

  • Image: the full featured image URL, or an opt-in PNG copy for an SVG.
  • Title: the article title, optionally followed by the site name.
  • Description: the excerpt when provided, otherwise plain text from the content, limited to about 200 characters.
  • Classification: one public category or taxonomy term, preferring a category or hierarchical taxonomy, at the start of the description.
  • Site name and URL: the WordPress site name and the page permalink.
  • Image accessibility: existing alternative text and dimensions, with the article title as an alternative-text fallback.

With a supported featured image, the plugin requests a large-image card. Without one, or while an SVG copy is unavailable, it requests a summary card. X determines whether and how a card is displayed. Card metadata does not insert text or mentions into the post composer.

Optional SVG support

X does not support SVG card images. Enable Convert SVG featured images to PNG for cards in settings and save to create separate PNG copies in your browser. The default is off. Original SVG files and featured image assignments are not changed. Keep the screen open until conversion finishes. Settings checks selected public articles in batches; opening or saving a selected post editor also checks that article. Public visitors never run conversion.

Only locally stored, self-contained SVG files up to 2 MB are supported. External resources, restricted URLs or unsupported markup may fail or look different; use a PNG/JPEG featured image if needed. Copies preserve the aspect ratio, use up to 1200 pixels on the longest side and must be at most 5 MB. They use uploads storage, are reused until the SVG changes, and are removed when the original attachment is deleted. Turning the option off stops using copies but keeps them for reuse. Unavailable copies fall back to an image-free summary card. Clear page caches after conversion and allow time for X to refresh.

Japanese support

Japanese translations for the plugin name, author, description and settings are bundled. Japanese WordPress installations can use them without a separate language pack. Official WordPress.org language packs take precedence when installed. Detailed Japanese instructions are included in readme-ja.txt. The English readme is the source for translations of the directory page.

Privacy and external services

The plugin adds metadata to the HTML of public pages. It does not collect visitor information, send data to an external conversion service, or require API keys or an X account connection. It adds no frontend scripts or styles. The preview loads on its settings screen. When SVG conversion is enabled, admin scripts read the featured SVG in your browser and send its PNG copy to the same WordPress site on settings and selected post editor screens. The server does not fetch remote SVG URLs.

When a URL is shared on X, X may fetch the public page and image according to its own service behavior. This plugin cannot force a re-fetch or clear the cache on X.

Independent plugin

IchimaruPlus OGP for X is an independent plugin by Ichimaru+. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by X. References to X describe the intended compatibility of the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install from the directory once published.
  2. Activate IchimaruPlus OGP for X.
  3. Open Settings > IchimaruPlus OGP for X, select the post types and save. The Settings link in the plugin list opens the same screen.
  4. Optionally choose Title – Site name and check the preview before saving.
  5. Set the usual title and featured image on the public page, then paste its URL into a post on X.

Existing public pages of selected types are included without saving them again. Clear your page cache after activation or changes to the selected scope or title format.
sections.faq:
Do I need a new image or description?

No. The plugin uses the featured image and the excerpt or content. It does not draw titles onto images. SVG featured images can optionally be converted to a separate PNG copy for cards.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes. Publicly viewable registered types appear in the settings. Select each type to include. Media attachments and non-public types are excluded.

What if there is no featured image?

The plugin requests a summary card without an image. The final display is controlled by X.

Why is a card missing or outdated?

Check that the post type is selected, the page and image are accessible without a login, and the content is not private or password-protected. Check for metadata from your theme or another plugin and clear your page cache. Recognized SEO integrations may cause this plugin to withhold its output. X may keep an older cached copy, so updates may take time.

Does it add share buttons or publish posts?

No. It supplies link-card metadata. It does not add share buttons, prefill post text, or publish to X.

Will the preview exactly match X?

No. The settings preview is an illustration using existing or sample content. X controls the actual layout, text truncation and image crop.

Can I use it with any theme?

The theme must call the standard wp_head() function. If that call is missing, the plugin cannot add metadata to the page head.

Where are the icons used?

The bundled icon appears on the settings screen. Directory and update-list icons are registered separately as official directory assets when the plugin is published. The standard installed-plugins list does not display icons. No custom updater is included.

Who is the author?

The author is Ichimaru+. The author website is https://ichimaruplus.com/.

1.0.2

  • Keep the official plugin name IchimaruPlus OGP for X in Japanese screens.

1.0.1

  • Bundle Japanese interface translations so a separate language pack is not required.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release with selectable post types, title formats, a settings preview, optional browser-based SVG conversion and WordPress.org language-pack support.

short_description: Set up X link cards from existing featured images, titles and categories, with selectable post types and a title preview.
